title: plt ledger event
description: One line of a run's events.jsonl. The ledger is append-only and a newer writer may add keys, so unknown properties pass; what is named here is what every reader depends on.

verdict.description: A reviewer's call on one receipt. Held to two words because gateCheck and bannerFails both key off `fail`.

result.description: Free text by construction: gateApprove/gateRevoke write `approve`/`revoke`, `plt receipt` writes pass/fail/skip, and a review receipt writes its round summary. No enum can cover all three, and pretending otherwise fails every healthy run.

actor.description: The ROLE that wrote the event, never the person — the person goes in `by`.

out_of_band.description: true on a receipt the spine did not collect: recorded for a step that was not in_progress or in_review, or back-filled by the landing path once GitHub said MERGED. It still counts toward the gate; renderers count it apart. Absent otherwise.

by.description: The person, bare, with no `human:` prefix (the prefix is CLI sugar and is stripped once, at the boundary).

pin.description: What computePin returned: `sha` when the worktree is clean (value = HEAD, tree = HEAD^{tree}), `tree` when work is staged (value = write-tree, base_sha = HEAD). `null` when the run has no resolvable repo — stated, not left to an absent key.
